checks.result: Source review: load returns nil only for NSCocoaErrorDomain no-such-file codes. Other attribute failures, FileHandle open/read errors, decode errors and validation errors propagate.
Source review: FileAttributeType.typeRegular is required before opening the path. Focused test source includes directory and symbolic-link rejection plus preservation assertions.

Source review: metadata size must be at most 1,048,576 bytes; actual reading stops at 1,048,577 bytes with chunks at most 65,536 bytes, and SceneCodec.decode rejects the extra byte. Focused test source checks maximum-plus-one rejection and exactly-maximum valid padded JSON.

Source review: SceneCodec.decode validates JSON and the scene; save calls load before encoding or filesystem mutation, so existing malformed bytes prevent replacement. SceneTests includes codec malformed/oversized rejection. No runtime outcome claimed.

Source review: save completes existing-file validation and SceneCodec.encode validation/size checking before directory creation and Data.write(options: .atomic); none of those throwing operations is suppressed.

Focused test source explicitly compares previous oversized bytes after rejected save and verifies a symbolic link and its target remain intact. Invalid replacement and malformed-existing-file preservation follow from source operation ordering; these cases are not directly asserted in the two inspected store/scene test files.
